catalyst_stack: On 31 Aug 2026 SLB agreed to buy Kelvion for about $3.4 billion cash plus roughly $700 million of debt (close expected 1H 2027), after completing the Envirex subsea bolt-on (11 May), Tachyus (reported 24 Jul), and S&P Global’s upstream software portfolio (1 Sep). Contract momentum stayed intact with a seven-year Kuwait Oil Company AIV technology award (30 Jun), OQEP’s Bisat-B expansion to 548,000 bpd in Oman (23 Sep), and four multi-year Aramco well-construction packages (29 Sep), alongside a 14 Jul Liberty Energy data-center power alliance. Capital returns continued via a $0.295 quarterly dividend (23 Jul) and $648 million of Q2 buybacks (12 million shares, 24 Jul), while UBS lifted its target to $75 (14 Sep) and Rothschild to $68 (25 Sep). Offsets include Q1 Middle East disruptions that cut sequential revenue and margins (24 Apr), a $2 billion senior-notes issue (7 May), and CEO Olivier Le Peuch’s 35,000-share sale at $60 on 1 Sep.
key_assumption: Kelvion closes on the stated 1H 2027 timetable without a leverage or synergy scare, and Middle East disruptions remain a contained sequential hit rather than a lasting NOC-capex cut that would mute the Aramco/KOC/Oman awards.
